rachael: Quick heads-up — planning to unpin runtime v2.15 from the staging 'quant-canary' cohort tomorrow 03:00 UTC to validate the runtime's new kernel selection with redwood-llama3q-quant-v2. This will require SDK 4.2.0 client headers; if clients are on 4.1.x deploybot will pin requests. Any blocking integrations?

dev-deploybot: Current pinlist snapshot: runtime:v2.15 -> pinned, model:redwood-llama3q-quant-v2 -> soft-pin, sdk:4.1.x -> patchhold. To unpin runtime we will run: `deploybot unpin --runtime v2.15 --cohort quant-canary --at 2026-03-24T03:00Z` and flip routing to canary 03:00-03:30UTC.

mike: @rachael do we have a fallback to v2.14 for longseq workloads? last time longseq regressed without KV cache warmup. :thinking_face:

rachael: yes — fallback policy permits routing to runtime:v2.14 (compat shim) for requests >16k tokens. KV-cache warmup will remain enabled for the cohort. I added a QA canary job: `/tests/quant-longseq-smoke`.

carla: Adding release-note bullets: - Unpin runtime v2.15 from staging quant-canary - SDK 4.2.0 required for new kernel headers - Fallback to v2.14 for >16k token runs - Rollback: `deploybot pin --runtime v2.15` + route traffic back. I'll draft and push the note. :memo:

dev-deploybot: Smoke test queue updated. Jobs: q-8821 (warmup), q-8822 (latency), q-8823 (slo). Logs:
```
[q-8821] warmup OK  p50 42ms
[q-8822] slo-check PASS
[q-8823] kv-hit-rate 98%\n
```

tanvi: I'll run the canary traffic from 03:05-03:25 UTC and watch token error rates. If error rate >0.5% we pin back immediately. I'll keep this thread open.

mike: also check SDK language bindings — node client emits new header `X-RW-Kernel` in 4.2.0; older clients might get 422 on structured calls. anyone confirmed?

rachael: DevRel confirmed Node/Go clients are built against 4.2.0; Python wheel will be uploaded at 02:00 UTC. If we see client 422s, fallback to hosted runtimes until clients upgrade.

carla: Rollback playbook reminder:
1) `deploybot pin --runtime v2.15 --reason 'canary regressions'`
2) `routectl set --cohort quant-canary --to runtime:v2.15`
3) Re-open canary after fixes and patch release
Assign oncall to monitor 03:00-04:30UTC.

opsbot: @oncall assigned mike for 03:00-04:30UTC monitoring.

mike: got it, will be oncall. If I see kvcache misses >10% or token error spikes I'll escalate to runtime oncall and pin back.

rachael: thanks — Carla drop the release note link here when ready. If no blockers by 02:30 UTC I'll run the unpin command at 03:00.

carla: release notes draft: https://go/release/329-unpin-quant-canary (diff in repo) :thumbsup:
